title: Sorting time bound
statement: For each natural number $n$, the specified time is $61n\lceil\log_2 n\rceil+74(n-1)+4$, where $\lceil\log_2 n\rceil$ denotes the natural-number ceiling logarithm returned by $\operatorname{clog}(2,n)$.
